newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mostly lower, quiet week ahead.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mostly lower, quiet week ahead.

text.p: Most Croatian stocks edged down in modest business on Tuesday with top shares holding ground, and traders said the market could see a quieter week.
"In general, I don't expect great trading. But some stocks might shine," said Josko Milisa of I.C.F brokerage.
He singled out confectioner Kras and Zagrebacka Banka as possible hot stocks of the week.
"There are rumours Kras will soon get a new loan from a bank," he said, but was unable to provide any details.
Kras lost seven kuna to 405 on Tuesday with 487 shares sold, after recouping part of its recent losses last week.
Ten of 16 active issues fell, two rose and four were flat. Volume was slightly higher at 7,524 shares, turnover also rose to 7.6 million kuna.
Most active issue was Zagrebacka Banka, trading flat at 2,000 kuna on volume of 2,809 ordinary shares.
"There is an abundance of buying orders for Zagrebacka and it could start rising again," Milisa said.
Zagrebacka's preference E-series stock was also flat at 1,200 kuna, while its bearer C-series shares inched down five kuna to 815.
Milisa predicted a period of stagantion for fully-listed drugs firm Pliva, which remained unchanged at 450 kuna with 965 units sold.
Two other stocks in the top segment, Varazdinska Banka ordinary and bearer shares, both lost 100 kuna to 39,900 and 1,100, respectively.
Top decliner electric manufacturer Koncar fell 200 kuna to 1,000 with 106 shares sold.
Food processor Podravka was also on the losing side, edging down 4.50 kuna to 275 on volume of 1,123 shares. Traders said most of its shares were sold for 271 kuna.
"Podravka fell some 10 percent in the past two weeks amid rumours its (1996) annual results are very bad," Milisa said.
Top gainer was hotelier Riviera Porec, which added eight kuna to 160, selling 1,134 units.
"Riviera is liquid in the price-range between 150-160 kuna and it could continue to be actively traded," Milisa said.
